middle and late Paleoproterozoic (Orosirian and Statherian) (2050 - 1600 Ma)

nativeOverlapPolicy.default: subtract guarded overlap with active native coast material across the complete 5 Ma sweep
nativeOverlapPolicy.novaya: preserve the complete guarded source-qualified mask; where Kara Block later overlaps, the shared renderer draws correction first without depth writes and gives visible native material visual and picking precedence

measurement.projection: spherical Lambert azimuthal equal-area centred at 40E, 75N

policy.nativeDeduplicationAgesMa: 410.001 Ma, 411 Ma, every 5 Ma from 415 through 540 inclusive, and 430.001 Ma
policy.recordedSequence: An exploratory screen measured approximate source/target areas and six overlap ages before this file existed. The thresholds and stop rule were then frozen before the reproducible compiler and expanded 5 Ma overlap sweep generated the tracked candidate. This is not a preregistered measurement. After the shared renderer overlap-precedence design was accepted, the Novaya candidate was regenerated from the already measured guarded source mask without the conservative all-age Kara subtraction.

sourceSelection.iceRule: ice records are admitted only when they intersect a Novaya Zemlya or Franz Josef Land Cao target; ice supplies footprint, while cited regional geology supplies the inferred older substrate
